metadata.title: Open ICS Advisory Dataset (OICSAD) v0.1.0
metadata.description: An open, reproducible dataset of every CISA ICS (ICSA) and ICS-medical (ICSMA) advisory published in CSAF 2.0 format, parsed into advisory-, advisory-CVE- and CVE-level tables, normalized for vendor and critical-infrastructure sector, and joined to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog. Sources are pinned to git commits of github.com/cisagov/CSAF and github.com/cisagov/kev-data. Includes code (MIT), QA report, codebook, limitations, and the BSides talk materials.
